map.3Y/4Y/5Y 氧化锆有什么区别？: What is the difference between 3Y, 4Y and 5Y zirconia?
map.→ 打开氧化锆透光率美学评估工具: -> Open the zirconia translucency aesthetic evaluation tool
map.为什么前牙特别重透光率？: Why does translucency matter so much for front teeth?
map.估算氧化锆全瓷修复体的可见光透光率，结合修复部位评估美学适配度。透光率越高越接近: Estimates the visible light transmittance of zirconia all-ceramic restorations and assesses aesthetic fit against the restoration site. Higher transmittance is closer to the translucency of a natural tooth, which matters most in the anterior aesthetic zone.
map.前牙全瓷冠修复，输入牙位与透光需求，工具推荐 4Y/5Y 高透氧化锆以接近天然牙: For anterior all-ceramic crown restorations, enter the tooth position and translucency requirement; the tool recommends 4Y/5Y high-translucency zirconia to approximate the translucency of a natural tooth.
map.后牙高咬合力区，权衡强度优先，推荐 3Y 常规透氧化锆并提示美学区慎用。: In the high-bite-force posterior region, strength comes first, so 3Y conventional-translucency zirconia is recommended with a caution against using it in the aesthetic zone.
map.天然前牙釉质半透，透光率不足会显死白、缺乏层次；高透氧化锆或唇面饰瓷更接近天然观: Natural front tooth enamel is translucent, and insufficient transmittance looks flat white and lifeless. High-translucency zirconia or facial veneering comes closer to the natural look.
map.存在权衡，高透代次强度略降；可由医师通过修复设计（厚度、粘接）补偿，本工具仅作初: There is a trade-off, in that the high-translucency grade is slightly less strong. The dentist can compensate through restoration design (thickness, bonding); this tool only gives a screening recommendation.
map.按牙位推荐代次: Recommend a grade by tooth position
map.数字代表氧化钇稳定剂含量，3Y 强度最高、透光较低；4Y 居中；5Y 透光最好、: The number indicates the yttria stabiliser content: 3Y has the highest strength and lower translucency, 4Y sits in the middle, and 5Y has the best translucency with slightly lower strength. The anterior aesthetic zone leans towards 4Y/5Y and the posterior bite-force zone towards 3Y.
map.比色后透光率与邻牙差异明显，提示选择更高透代次或唇面饰瓷调整。（结果仅供口腔健康: If the shade-matched translucency differs noticeably from the neighbouring teeth, choose a more translucent grade or adjust with facial veneering. (Results are for oral health education and self-screening only, and do not replace an oral examination, imaging such as periapical radiographs or CBCT, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists or periodontists; if you have toothache, bleeding gums, an ulcer that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or discomfort on biting, please see a dentist at a proper hospital promptly.)
map.透光率和强度能兼得吗？: Can translucency and strength both be achieved?
map.：输入：修复牙位=上颌中切牙，美学需求=高，比色=2M2\n输出：推荐 5Y 高:
Input: restoration site = upper central incisor, aesthetic requirement = high, shade = 2M2.
Output: recommend 5Y high-translucency zirconia (translucency close to natural enamel), with facial veneering to add depth if needed; for posterior sites 3Y is recommended to also protect flexural strength.
